basic_info.description: Motivated - Bring Offers - We are d to present the opportunity to purchase a mixed-use property with two buildings on one parcel in San Francisco's highly desirable Cow Hollow. The front building, with Union Street frontage consists of a retail storefront on the ground floor and a commercial office on the second. While the back building consists of two 2x2 apartments and one commercial/storage unit on the ground floor which is occupied by the retail tenant. While this property is currently 100% leased, this extremely well-located property is ideal for any investor, but also lends its hand to a potential owner-user and SBA Financing, as the retail unit will be delivered vacant but sellers will considering a short term Sale Leaseback.
